items.title: Puka Nacua: Back at practice Sunday
items.body_text: Nacua (groin) is practicing Sunday, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Makes initial 53-man roster
items.body_text: Tracy (neck) is on the Giants' initial 53-man roster for the 2026 season, Dan Salomone and Matt Citak of the team's official site report. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Opening season on reserve/PUP list
items.body_text: The Seahawks moved Charbonnet (knee) from the active/PUP list to the reserve/PUP list Sunday, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Lands on IR, designated to return
items.body_text: Tyson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return by New Orleans on Sunday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Anthony Richardson: Will continue with Colts
items.body_text: Richardson remains on the 53-man roster for the Colts. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
